mapper.select: WITH tile_bounds AS ( SELECT ST_TileEnvelope(#{z}, #{x}, #{y}) AS bounds, ST_Expand(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z}, #{x}, #{y}), (ST_XMax(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z}, #{x}, #{y})) - ST_XMin(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z}, #{x}, #{y}))) * 256.0 / 4096.0 ) AS buffered_bounds ) SELECT ST_AsMVT(tile, 'railways', 4096, 'geom') AS mvt FROM ( SELECT id, name, category, railway, usage, electrified, max_speed, track_count, length_km, CASE WHEN usage = 'main' THEN 'trunk' WHEN usage = 'branch' THEN 'branch' WHEN usage = 'spur' THEN 'spur' ELSE 'trunk' END AS display_group, ST_AsMVTGeom( ST_Transform(rs.geom, 3857), tb.bounds, 4096, 256, true ) AS geom FROM railway_segments rs CROSS JOIN tile_bounds tb WHERE rs.geom && ST_Transform(tb.buffered_bounds, 4326) AND category IN ('conventional', 'high_speed') ) AS tile WHERE geom IS NOT NULL

SELECT id, osm_id, name, railway, usage, category, electrified, gauge, max_speed, track_count, ST_AsText(geom) AS geom_wkt, length_km, source_grid, data_quality FROM railway_segments WHERE geom && ${envelope} AND ST_Intersects(geom, ${envelope}) LIMIT #{limit}
